caption: The video showcases a close oblique view of a long white board with a serpentine groove against an off-white wall. A glossy red ball is already rolling in the channel. The ball rises over rounded crests and drops into troughs, advancing relative to the board as its vertical position oscillates. A thin diagonal seam shifts toward the left frame edge, showing the camera tracking along the surface rather than staying fixed. The ball crosses the seam from left to right while remaining near the center of the view. A bright highlight moves across the ball's curved surface, and pale wood becomes more visible at the lower-right edge. The rolling continues through the last frame without showing how the ball entered the groove or where the track leads afterward.
relations: As the ball rolls forward, its vertical position oscillates over the groove's rounded crests and troughs.
The camera tracking shifts the diagonal seam leftward while the ball crosses it from left to right.
A bright highlight moves across the ball's curved surface as it advances through the channel.
Pale wood becomes more visible at the lower-right edge as the camera pans along the surface.
